## Add comprehensive E2E test suite with Playwright

### Summary

• Introduce a full Playwright E2E test suite covering all major user flows: landing pages, authentication, dashboard, all-trades table, trade creation/editing/deletion, sidebar features (navigation, language/theme, logout, subscription, emotion tracker, notes, strategy checklist), and column/filter/search/export functionality
• Add reusable test infrastructure including auth fixtures with persistent sessions, trade helper utilities for creating/cleaning up trades across all 10 strategy types, and a global setup for dev server warm-up
• Fix minor app issues found during E2E development: replace `router.push` with `<Link>` in landing header for testability, switch trade deletion from `router.refresh()` to `refetch()` for reliable UI updates, add `data-testid` and `aria-label` attributes to sidebar buttons, and add test IDs to landing page elements

### Changes

*E2E Infrastructure*

• `playwright.config.ts` -- project-based config with separate auth setup, unauthenticated, authenticated, and isolated logout projects
• `e2e/auth.setup.ts` -- persistent auth setup for 3 test users (with trades, no trades, no subscription)
• `e2e/fixtures/` -- custom Playwright fixtures, constants, and base fixture
• `e2e/global-setup.ts` -- dev server warm-up to prevent cache race conditions
• `e2e/utils/trade-helpers.ts` -- ~420 lines of reusable helpers for asset selection, strategy selection, leg filling, trade creation, and cleanup for all 10 global strategies
• `e2e/utils/helpers.ts`, `e2e/utils/test-data.ts` -- shared navigation and test data utilities
• `e2e/README.md`, `e2e/IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md` -- documentation

*Test Specs (34 files, ~3700 lines)*

• Landing: home, pricing, contact, legal pages
• Auth: sign-in, sign-up, password reset, request password
• Dashboard: data display, date filters, gross/net toggle
• All-trades: search, filters, column visibility, CSV export
• Trades: create (all 10 strategies with validation), edit/delete, emotion tracker, notes, strategy checklist
• Sidebar: navigation, language/theme switching, subscription paywall, logout (self-contained with fresh login per test)

*App Source Changes*

• `src/features/landing-page-v2/components/header.tsx` -- replace `router.push` with `<Link>` for proper navigation, add `id` attributes for test targeting
• `src/features/landing-page-v2/components/hero.tsx` -- add `id="hero-section"`
• `src/features/sidebar/Sidebar.tsx` -- add `data-testid` and `aria-label` to desktop sidebar buttons
• `src/features/options-testballoon/all-trades/components/all-trades.tsx` -- use `refetch()` instead of `router.refresh()` after trade deletion

*Config & DB*

• `supabase/migrations/20260131091252_add_iron_condor_strategy.sql` -- add all 10 production global strategies with leg configs and constraint rules
• `supabase/seed.sql` -- streamlined seed data for consistent test environment
• `vitest.config.ts` -- exclude `e2e/**` to prevent Vitest from processing Playwright files
• `.eslintrc.js` -- ignore `e2e/*` from ESLint
• `.gitignore` -- ignore Playwright reports, test results, auth state, and temp files
• `package.json` -- add `@playwright/test` dependency and convenience scripts (`test:e2e`, `test:e2e:ui`, per-feature scripts)

### Test plan

• Run `yarn test:e2e` with a fresh `supabase db reset` to verify the full suite passes
• Run individual suites (`yarn test:e2e:trades`, `yarn test:e2e:all-trades`, etc.) to verify isolation
• Run `yarn test:e2e -- e2e/tests/sidebar/logout.spec.ts` independently to confirm it logs in fresh and doesn't depend on other projects
• Verify `yarn test:push` (Vitest) still works without picking up e2e files
• Confirm seed data and migration produce a consistent test-ready database state
